name: Implicit Neural Point Clouds (INPC)
definition: A point-based neural radiance field method using an implicit point cloud structure with a multi-resolution hash grid and MLP for rendering, utilizing differentiable rasterization via bilinear splatting.
summary: Implicit Neural Point Clouds is a point-based neural radiance field method using hash-encoded MLPs and differentiable bilinear splatting to enable efficient, continuous feature representation and gradient-based optimization.
